purpose: Create a private SmartGift Customer Profile projection in Zuri CRM from the approved read-only DuckDB snapshot.

privacy.retentionRule: Retain only while necessary for SmartGift customer-profile operations; review at least annually and delete or anonymize when no longer necessary or on a validated erasure request.
privacy.decisionNote: Scoped owner attestation for this migration; it does not create Organization Owner membership and is not a legal opinion outside this approval record.

historicalWindow.decisionBasis: Full observed SmartGift source date window in the read-only snapshot; customer profile rows are included as present at snapshotAsOf, while transaction/document fields remain excluded from initial publish.

limitations: This approval is limited to CDC-SG-CUSTOMER-DATA-001 and MIS-SG-CUSTOMER-DATA-BACKFILL-001.
It does not assign Tenant or Organization Owner membership.
It does not authorize cross-business merge, LINE replay, financial/document import or raw PII publication.
The 130 review-required rows remain held until an explicit row-level review decision.
